[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Eastern Frontier | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=107 }} Ascalon's [[Eastern Frontier]] was once a lush green land of rolling hills. Now, as with the rest of Ascalon, it is a blasted piece of barren land littered with ruins. Large sections of the once great wall lie broken and breached in several places as the [[Charr]] make their presence felt, establishing a foothold in the northeast. Aside from the Charr, the [[Grawl]] appear to have flourished as well, having a heavy presence to the northwest. Further south, the broken land has become a haven for [[Devourer]]s waiting to ambush unsuspecting prey. ==Getting there== This area lies to the east of [[Frontier Gate]] and the [[Ruins of Surmia (outpost)|Ruins of Surmia mission outpost]]. This man will have to explain himself and his actions when he reaches the Mists.'' == Notes == * If you fight near [[Guardsman Noell]] (a [[collector]]), he will join in the fight. * The [[Frontier Gate]] [[resurrection shrine]] is not visible; you will resurrect near the stairs leading to the portal. * Complete exploration of this area contributes approximately 1.36% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. *{{Vanquisher|count = 190|low = 180|high = 216|notes=There are many hidden [[Devourer]] groups in this area, concentrated mostly in the southern half.}} ** [[Grawl Ulodyte]]s in [[hard mode]] are strong healers. If your party has trouble, [[interrupt]] or otherwise prevent their use of [[Heal Area]]. Otherwise, attempt to move them away from their allies. It may be beneficial to start vanquishing from Ruins of Surmia. ** During [[Frontier Gate Fugitives]], [[Footman Tate]] is a useful [[ally]] and will follow your [[party]] around until he is led back to [[Frontier Gate]]. ** During [[The Last Day Dawns]] active, almost all visible foes are [[Charr]] and the total number of foes increases slightly. Take advantage of [[:Category:Ebon Vanguard rank skills|Ebon Vanguard PvE skills]] (and especially [[Rebel Yell]]). Use caution if you trigger the quest foes: if [[King Adelbern]] dies, the quest will fail, forcing your party to return to an outpost. {{bug|Occasionally a group of Grawl might spawn inside a rock on one of the cliff faces between Surmia and Frontier Gate, preventing you from retrieving their drops.}} {{bug|There is a cliff just east of Ruins of Surmia that does not clip correctly, allowing you to slide down.}} == Trivia== *According to a list on Guild Wars Guru, which seems to list various beta locations, this zone was previously called ''The Shift''.[https://web.archive.org/web/20050301030823/http://www.guildwarsguru.com/ascalon-id13.php List of Ascalon locations], Guild Wars Guru (archived) == References == {{Explorable areas in Ascalon}} [[de:Ostgrenze]]
